description: October 21 birthday meaning: Libra decan 3, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 21 birthday falls in Libra, in the third decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Libra is cardinal and air.

sections.heading: Personality of an October 21 birthday
paragraphs: Late Libra at twenty-seven degrees gives October 21 a lively, sociable Mercury decan, and twenty-one reduces to 3, the number most associated with self-expression. That makes this one of the most talkative-looking dates in the season. Astrologers might picture a performer, presenter or storyteller who charms an audience and enjoys the polish of a well-turned phrase.

By noon UTC on October 21, the Sun has normally reached roughly 27° of Libra. That places the date in the Libra decan that astrologers give to Mercury, the third of three. Mercury, ruler of Gemini, colours the final decan of Libra, which runs from around October 14 to October 23. The scales here are weighed with words. Mid-October birthdays are often described as articulate, sociable and quick to see both sides of an argument, sometimes simultaneously. Writing, negotiation, teaching and any role that depends on good conversation tend to suit them. Mercury can add restlessness and a habit of debating rather than deciding. When this decan commits to a view and explains it with Libra's courtesy, it can change minds that more forceful voices never reach.

sections.heading: Numerology of the October 21 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 21st, your compound reduces as 2 + 1 = 3. Unlike the 12th, where the individual comes first, here the 2 of partnership leads and the 1 follows, which numerologists sometimes read as creativity that grows out of relationships. The resulting 3 is expressive, social and optimistic. Twenty-first-born people are often described as charming and versatile, able to bring people together and make collaborative projects enjoyable. As a supporting number, the 21 tends to show in how easily they connect. Seeing a shared project through to the end can be their most valued contribution.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same October 21 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 4 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: October 21 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 21 is the 294th day of the year (295th in a leap year). In most years Scorpio season is under way by October 24, 3 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an October 21 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. October 21 is also the birthday of Alfred Nobel (1833), Benjamin Netanyahu (1949) and Samuel Taylor Coleridge (1772).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 21?
faq.answer: October 21 is Libra in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Libra, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 21?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 21 the Life Path is 11 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 4 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 21st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 21?
faq.answer: By October 21 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 21?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an October 21 birthday are Alfred Nobel (1833), Benjamin Netanyahu (1949) and Samuel Taylor Coleridge (1772). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
